caption: The query is analyzed into terms, looked up in the postings lists of the inverted index, scored by TF-IDF or BM25, and the highest scorers come back as a ranked list. Analysis happens before any scoring, and the index holds candidates, not an answer.

spec.title: Retrieval pipeline
spec.aria: An information retrieval pipeline: the query is analyzed into terms, looked up in an inverted index, ranked by TF-IDF or BM25, and the top-k documents are returned as a ranked list.
